story.title: The two friends
paragraphs_en: Once upon a time, there lived a girl named priyanshi she had a neighbour named advit, they were friends but one-day advit told priyanshi that let's play with cars, priyanshi said no let's play with dolls. then priyanshi got irritated by advits shouting which was didi lets play with cars. poor priyanshi had to agree because it was better to play with cars by hearing that irritating noise.

The next morning advit came to priyanshi's house, but priyanshi was studying, so she told to wait for 5 min. After 5 min as told she closed the laptop and told advit now lets play when she turned around she saw advit was gone to his house. She went to call advit, and he told no I am playing chess i want to play chess. Then priyanshi said no i am going hmm you always dont have patince only.

And on priyanshi's way home she heard advit telling that जभी भी में दीदी को बुलाने जाता हु तब तो आती ही नहीं है. Priyanshi was very short-tempered because he was telling lies, she was completing her homework.
When after advit came to priyanshi the scene was........ priyanshi- you were not coming when I called you now but you did not come so I completed playing. just then priyanshi's parents join.
they tell them not to fight on the things, priyanshi's mother shouts her and advit's father shouts on him. let's see what happens next.
The next day priyanshi calls advit, they talk, listen to music which is English and suddenly......
shouts priyanshi hey, let's play. Advit- ya it's better to play than fighting

advit says let us play with dolls. (priyanshi in shock) what are you okay, you used to tell me to play with cars. she checks advits temperature by keeping hand on his head. No, to keep a friendship between us we need to play cars and dolls together right,? yes you are right.
it's my birthday didi do come because I am alone in lockdown. ya, sure I will. this is a true event that happened to me.
